title: Wizart.ai
cardSummary: An ecosystem for material visualization and 3D content, helping shoppers see a product in their own space before they buy it.
sub: A product ecosystem for visualizing interior finishing materials — paints, wallpaper, flooring — across mobile, web and enterprise tools.

cover.alt: Wizart.ai material visualization on a phone

sections.heading: Overview
sections.headline: A product ecosystem for visualising interior materials
paragraphs: Wizart helps shoppers see a product in their own space before they buy it: paints, wallpaper and flooring across mobile, web and enterprise tools.
I designed new features, led research, ideation, prototyping and usability testing together with product and engineering teams, and kept the design documentation consistent across releases.

sections.heading: 01 — Product ecosystem
sections.headline: Four connected services
paragraphs: The platform includes several interconnected services.

sections.heading: 02 — Research
sections.headline: Hypotheses tested where purchases happen
paragraphs: Ongoing research through surveys and in-store observations in construction retail validated hypotheses and shaped new product directions based on real purchasing behaviour.

sections.heading: 03 — Analytics
sections.headline: Decisions guided by data, not opinion
list: Usage of custom vs. predefined interiors
Conversion funnel: product selection → cart → checkout
Most frequently used materials and products
Behavioural insights gathered via Microsoft Clarity

sections.heading: 04 — Design system
sections.headline: Atomic design for a scalable ecosystem
paragraphs: A structured system built on atomic design principles kept the product scalable and consistent — reusable navigation, forms, tables and controls, shared across every product in the ecosystem.

sections.heading: 05 — Marketing and print
sections.headline: Beyond the digital product
paragraphs: I also designed brochures, catalogs, flyers, books and exhibition stands, refined through continuous feedback loops with the client.

result: Improvements shipped on the back of usage analytics increased feature adoption by 12%.
